english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for food that gives a hot, burning sensation.

exampleSentences.english: This dish is so spicy that it makes me sweat.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 wun2 laat6 dou3 ngo5 ceot1 saai3 hon6

english.note: Use this instead of 熱 when the heat is the spicy pungency of food or chilies.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 wun2 gaa3 lei1 zan1 hai6 hou2 laat6
